title: Port FACe invoice submission to the TypeScript client
blocker: Facturae 3.2.2 signing and the archived WS-Security envelope are implemented offline. The live supplier WSDL was retrieved, but does not declare a WS-Security policy. The current request signature and signed sandbox receipt remain unverified.
unblock: Confirm the current SOAP security profile and response signing seal using the official integration guide and a sanitized accepted sandbox exchange, then verify the envelope and receipt handling.
notes: `facturae.py`, XAdES SHA-512 byte-compatible with AutoFirma through
`afirma_bridge.py`). Port it here with the local XAdES signer rather than
the AutoFirma bridge. Needs the Facturae profile and digest items under
Signing, plus a WS-Security envelope signer.
Verified the offline invoice and legacy SOAP with xmlsec1 and synthetic data. No invoice was transmitted.

The public supplier WSDL at https://ws.face.gob.es/proveedores/v1/factura?wsdl responded HTTP 200. It contains an inline RPC-literal SOAP 1.1 contract with FacturaFile.factura and FacturaFile.nombre, without the legacy mime field.
